reason: The initial history index identified the earlier current-path copy as latest. This addendum records the immutable rerun after restoring first-committed evidence paths and changing validator behavior.

current_immutable_record.note: Created with exclusive file creation. Existing evidence is never overwritten; add this record to an append-only lineage artifact in the accompanying change.

previous_copy_retained_as_noncurrent.meaning: Byte-preserving copy of the commit-time outputs before the validator was changed to use dedicated immutable evidence paths. Its summary refers to the old audit pathname; it is retained for history and is not the validator default comparison target.

validator_policy.normal_run: Regenerate both JSON values in memory and compare byte-for-byte to the current immutable record; do not write evidence.
validator_policy.record_run: --record --record-id <unique-id> creates a new directory and each artifact with exclusive creation; existing paths fail instead of overwriting.

limits: All snapshots are static source/document checks; none records execution or approval.
Historical full audits remain in their original Git commit blobs and are identified by the checkpoint manifests; no projection payload was discarded.
